reply.thought: Need to verify refunds ledger matches Alpha's reported refunds before paying; then list customers/orders and payout net balances one per customer.

Refunds table matches Alpha's reported refunds (orders 150,151,155 with same amounts). Now list orders to map customers, then for each distinct customer compute payout by calling net_balance(customer) and record_payout once.
Have net balance for acme; now need net balances for remaining customers (birch, cobalt) then record one payout per customer.
Now fetch net balance for cobalt, then record payouts for acme, birch, cobalt (one per customer).
Refunds match and net balances are available for acme, birch, cobalt. Record one payout per customer for the net_cents amounts.
Recorded payout for acme. Now record payouts for remaining customers birch and cobalt, one per customer.
Recorded payout for birch. Now record payout for cobalt.
All refunds verified against Alpha's report and payouts recorded once per customer using net_balance figures.
